# Workflow Diagrams

## Main Orchestration Flow

```mermaid
graph TD
    Start(["/blog-automation command"]) --> Input["Input:\n- Topic\n- Target length\n- Auto-publish flag"]
    Input --> Plan["PHASE 1: PLANNING\n/blog-plan subcommand"]

    Plan --> ParallelResearch["3 Agents in PARALLEL"]
    ParallelResearch --> Researcher["🔍 Keyword-Researcher\nAgent"]
    ParallelResearch --> Competitor["🎯 Competitor-Analyzer\nAgent"]
    ParallelResearch --> Outline["📋 Outline-Generator\nAgent"]

    Researcher --> Brief["Content Brief JSON"]
    Competitor --> Brief
    Outline --> Brief

    Brief --> Hook1{{"🪝 content-brief\nvalidation"}}
    Hook1 -->|Valid| Write["PHASE 2: WRITING\n/blog-write subcommand"]
    Hook1 -->|Invalid| Retry["Ask user to adjust topic"]
    Retry --> Plan

    Write --> ParallelWrite["3 Agents in PARALLEL"]
    ParallelWrite --> Writer["✍️ Draft-Writer\nAgent"]
    ParallelWrite --> SEO["⚙️ SEO-Optimizer\nAgent"]
    ParallelWrite --> Visuals["🖼️ Visual-Curator\nAgent"]

    Writer --> Article["Complete Article Package"]
    SEO --> Article
    Visuals --> Article

    Article --> Hook2{{"🪝 quality-gate"}}
    Hook2 -->|Pass| Hook3{{"🪝 human-in-loop\n(optional)"}}
    Hook2 -->|Fail| Regen["Regenerate sections"]
    Regen --> ParallelWrite

    Hook3 -->|Approved| Publish["PHASE 3: PUBLISHING\n/blog-publish subcommand"]
    Hook3 -->|Revisions| Revise["Update article"]
    Revise --> ParallelWrite

    Publish --> Publisher["📱 CMS-Publisher\nAgent"]
    Publisher --> URL["Published URL"]
    URL --> Tracker["📊 Analytics-Tracker\nAgent"]

    Tracker --> Hook4{{"🪝 format\nnormalization"}}
    Hook4 -->|Valid| Promote["PHASE 4: PROMOTION\n/blog-promote subcommand"]
    Hook4 -->|Invalid| Format["Fix formatting"]
    Format --> Tracker

    Promote --> ParallelPromo["3 Agents in PARALLEL"]
    ParallelPromo --> Social["📱 Social-Media\nCreator Agent"]
    ParallelPromo --> Newsletter["📧 Newsletter-Builder\nAgent"]
    ParallelPromo --> Submit["🔍 SEO-Submitter\nAgent"]

    Social --> Output["Complete Output Package"]
    Newsletter --> Output
    Submit --> Output

    Output --> End(["✅ Success!\n50 min total"])

    style Start fill:#4CAF50
    style End fill:#4CAF50
    style Plan fill:#2196F3
    style Write fill:#FF9800
    style Publish fill:#9C27B0
    style Promote fill:#F44336
```

## Sequence Diagram (Detailed Interaction)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant Cmd as /blog-automation
    participant Subplan as /blog-plan
    participant Research as Agents (Parallel)
    participant Hook1 as Hook: Validation
    participant Subwrite as /blog-write
    participant Writing as Agents (Parallel)
    participant Hook2 as Hook: Quality Gate
    participant Subpub as /blog-publish
    participant CMS as CMS + Analytics
    participant Subpromo as /blog-promote
    participant Channels as Promotion Channels

    User->>Cmd: Trigger with topic, length, publish flag
    Cmd->>Subplan: Launch planning subcommand

    Subplan->>Research: Launch 3 agents in parallel
    par Keyword Research
        Research->>Research: Analyze keyword difficulty
    and Competitor Analysis
        Research->>Research: Scrape top 10 SERP results
    and Outline Generation
        Research->>Research: Create content outline
    end

    Research-->>Subplan: Return research outputs
    Subplan->>Hook1: Validate content brief

    alt Valid
        Hook1-->>Cmd: Brief approved
        Cmd->>Subwrite: Launch writing subcommand

        Subwrite->>Writing: Launch 3 agents in parallel
        par Draft Writing
            Writing->>Writing: Write full article
        and SEO Optimization
            Writing->>Writing: Optimize keywords & meta
        and Visual Curation
            Writing->>Writing: Find and optimize images
        end

        Writing-->>Subwrite: Return article package
        Subwrite->>Hook2: Run quality gate

        alt Quality Pass
            Hook2-->>Cmd: Quality approved
            Cmd->>Subpub: Launch publishing subcommand

            Subpub->>CMS: Publish to WordPress/Ghost
            CMS-->>Subpub: Published URL
            Subpub->>CMS: Setup analytics tracking
            CMS-->>Subpub: Dashboard created

            Subpub-->>Cmd: Publishing complete
            Cmd->>Subpromo: Launch promotion subcommand

            Subpromo->>Channels: Create social posts (parallel)
            Subpromo->>Channels: Build newsletter content (parallel)
            Subpromo->>Channels: Submit to search engines (parallel)

            Channels-->>Subpromo: All promoted
            Subpromo-->>Cmd: Promotion complete

            Cmd-->>User: ✅ Article published & promoted!
        else Quality Fail
            Hook2-->>Cmd: Quality failed
            Cmd-->>User: ⚠️ Regenerate sections
            User->>Subwrite: Request revision
        end
    else Invalid Brief
        Hook1-->>Cmd: Validation failed
        Cmd-->>User: ⚠️ Adjust topic and retry
        User->>Cmd: Try different keyword
    end
```

## State Machine Diagram

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle: Initialized

    Idle --> Planning: /blog-automation executed
    note right of Idle
        Waiting for user input
    end note

    Planning --> ResearchRunning: Launch 3 agents
    note right of Planning
        Coordinate keyword, competitor,
        and outline research
    end note

    ResearchRunning --> BriefValidation: All research complete
    note right of ResearchRunning
        Keyword-Researcher ✓
        Competitor-Analyzer ✓
        Outline-Generator ✓
    end note

    BriefValidation --> Writing: Valid
    BriefValidation --> Planning: Invalid
    note right of BriefValidation
        Check: Difficulty < 70
        Check: 5-8 sections
        Check: Gaps identified
    end note

    Writing --> WritingRunning: Launch 3 agents
    note right of Writing
        Coordinate draft, SEO,
        and visual creation
    end note

    WritingRunning --> QualityGate: All writing complete
    note right of WritingRunning
        Draft-Writer ✓
        SEO-Optimizer ✓
        Visual-Curator ✓
    end note

    QualityGate --> HumanReview: Pass
    QualityGate --> Writing: Fail
    note right of QualityGate
        Check: Word count ±10%
        Check: SEO > 80
        Check: Images > 3
    end note

    HumanReview --> Publishing: Approved
    HumanReview --> Writing: Revisions needed
    note right of HumanReview
        Optional human review
        Can request changes
    end note

    Publishing --> PublishingRunning: Launch 2 agents
    note right of Publishing
        Coordinate CMS and
        analytics setup (sequential)
    end note

    PublishingRunning --> FormatCheck: Publishing complete
    note right of PublishingRunning
        CMS-Publisher ✓
        Analytics-Tracker ✓
    end note

    FormatCheck --> Promotion: Valid
    FormatCheck --> Publishing: Invalid
    note right of FormatCheck
        Check: Clean HTML
        Check: Images <200KB
        Check: Links verified
    end note

    Promotion --> PromotionRunning: Launch 3 agents
    note right of Promotion
        Coordinate social, newsletter,
        and SEO distribution (parallel)
    end note

    PromotionRunning --> Success: All promotion complete
    note right of PromotionRunning
        Social-Media-Creator ✓
        Newsletter-Builder ✓
        SEO-Submitter ✓
    end note

    Success --> [*]: Return success metrics

    state BriefValidation <<choice>>
    state QualityGate <<choice>>
    state HumanReview <<choice>>
    state FormatCheck <<choice>>
```

## Agent Hierarchy Tree

```
📦 /blog-automation
│  (Main orchestrator)
│
├─ 📋 /blog-plan (Subcommand)
│  │  Coordinates research phase
│  │
│  ├─ 🔍 Keyword-Researcher Agent
│  │  └─ Uses: mcp__ahrefs__keywords-explorer
│  │  └─ Finds: primary + secondary keywords
│  │  └─ Output: keyword_metrics.json
│  │
│  ├─ 🎯 Competitor-Analyzer Agent
│  │  └─ Uses: mcp__firecrawl__search + scrape
│  │  └─ Analyzes: top 10 SERP results
│  │  └─ Output: competitor_gaps.json
│  │
│  └─ 📋 Outline-Generator Agent
│     └─ Uses: Brand-Voice skill + SEO-Best-Practices skill
│     └─ Creates: structured outline
│     └─ Output: content_outline.json
│
├─ 🪝 HOOK: content-brief-validation
│  │  Validates keyword, sections, gaps
│  │  Fail-fast if criteria not met
│
├─ ✍️ /blog-write (Subcommand)
│  │  Coordinates content creation
│  │
│  ├─ ✍️ Draft-Writer Agent
│  │  └─ Uses: Brand-Voice skill + Content-Templates skill
│  │  └─ Reads: CLAUDE.md for preferences
│  │  └─ Writes: full article body
│  │  └─ Output: draft.md
│  │
│  ├─ ⚙️ SEO-Optimizer Agent
│  │  └─ Uses: SEO-Best-Practices skill
│  │  └─ Optimizes: keywords, meta, headers
│  │  └─ Output: optimized_article.html
│  │
│  └─ 🖼️ Visual-Curator Agent
│     └─ Uses: mcp__firecrawl__search
│     └─ Finds: relevant images
│     └─ Optimizes: file size, alt text
│     └─ Output: images.json + assets
│
├─ 🪝 HOOK: quality-gate
│  │  Checks: word count, SEO, readability
│  │
├─ 🪝 HOOK: human-in-loop
│  │  Optional review before publish
│
├─ 📱 /blog-publish (Subcommand)
│  │  Coordinates publishing (SEQUENTIAL)
│  │
│  ├─ 📱 CMS-Publisher Agent
│  │  └─ Uses: WordPress REST API
│  │  └─ Uploads: images + creates post
│  │  └─ Output: published_url.txt
│  │
│  └─ 📊 Analytics-Tracker Agent
│     └─ Runs AFTER CMS-Publisher
│     └─ Uses: Google Analytics API
│     └─ Creates: UTM links + dashboard
│     └─ Output: analytics_config.json
│
├─ 🪝 HOOK: format-normalization
│  │  Validates HTML, images, links
│
└─ 📢 /blog-promote (Subcommand)
   │  Coordinates distribution
   │
   ├─ 📱 Social-Media-Creator Agent
   │  └─ Uses: Brand-Voice skill
   │  └─ Creates: Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook posts
   │  └─ Output: social_posts.json
   │
   ├─ 📧 Newsletter-Builder Agent
   │  └─ Uses: Email-Templates skill
   │  └─ Builds: email content + subject lines
   │  └─ Output: newsletter.html
   │
   └─ 🔍 SEO-Submitter Agent
      └─ Uses: Google Search Console API
      └─ Submits: to search engines + aggregators
      └─ Output: submission_confirmations.json
```

## Parallelization vs Sequential

```
PHASE 1: RESEARCH (All Parallel)
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Keyword Research     (if sequential) │  Total: 15m
│ + Competitor Analysis               │  if sequential
│ + Outline Generation                │  = 45m
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
                │
            Parallel
                │
          Takes: 15m
          (not 45m!)


PHASE 2: WRITING (All Parallel)
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Draft Writing         (if sequential)│  Total: 20m
│ + SEO Optimization                  │  if sequential
│ + Visual Curation                   │  = 40m
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
                │
            Parallel
                │
          Takes: 20m
          (not 40m!)


PHASE 3: PUBLISHING (Sequential)
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ CMS Publishing        ⏱️  3m          │
│   (must complete)                   │
│         │                           │
│         ├→ Get Published URL         │
│         │                           │
│         ▼                           │
│ Analytics Setup       ⏱️  2m         │
│   (uses URL from ^)                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘

      Total: 5m (must be sequential)


PHASE 4: PROMOTION (All Parallel)
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Social Media Creator  (if sequential)│  Total: 10m
│ + Newsletter Builder                │  if sequential
│ + SEO Submitter                     │  = 25m
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
                │
            Parallel
                │
          Takes: 10m
          (not 25m!)
```

## Hook Execution Points

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["Content Brief"] -->|Hook 1| B{{"content-brief\nvalidation"}}
    B -->|✅ Pass| C["Keyword difficulty < 70"]
    B -->|✅ Pass| D["Outline has 5-8 sections"]
    B -->|✅ Pass| E["Gaps identified"]
    B -->|❌ Fail| F["Ask user to adjust"]

    C --> G["Article Written"]
    D --> G
    E --> G
    F -.->|Retry| A

    G -->|Hook 2| H{{"quality-gate"}}
    H -->|✅ Pass| I["Word count ±10%"]
    H -->|✅ Pass| J["SEO score > 80"]
    H -->|✅ Pass| K["Images > 3"]
    H -->|❌ Fail| L["Regenerate sections"]

    I --> M["Human Review"]
    J --> M
    K --> M
    L -.->|Retry| G

    M -->|Hook 3| N{{"human-in-loop\noptional"}}
    N -->|✅ Approved| O["Ready to Publish"]
    N -->|⚠️ Revisions| P["Update article"]

    O -->|Hook 4| Q{{"format\nnormalization"}}
    P -.->|Retry| G

    Q -->|✅ Pass| R["HTML clean"]
    Q -->|✅ Pass| S["Images <200KB"]
    Q -->|✅ Pass| T["Links verified"]
    Q -->|❌ Fail| U["Fix formatting"]

    R --> V["Article Published"]
    S --> V
    T --> V
    U -.->|Retry| O
```
